title: 5.5.3 Two-Player Pong-Sumo — Challenge
description: Two sprites, two control schemes, one ball. Push the ball past the other player's side to score.

steps.title: Two paddles
steps.instructions: Player 1 (left) uses W / S. Player 2 (right) uses ArrowUp / ArrowDown. Constrain each to their half.

steps.title: Ball in the middle
steps.instructions: A bouncy dynamic sprite with a high bounciness, no gravity, an initial vel.x/vel.y.

steps.title: Score zones
steps.instructions: If ball.x < 0 → p2 scores. If ball.x > width → p1 scores. Reset the ball to the center after each score.

steps.title: Win condition
steps.instructions: First to 5 wins. Show the winner in draw().

requirements.title: Two players use different keys
requirements.description: kb.pressing called with at least two different keys

requirements.title: Displays scores with text()
requirements.description: Calls text(...) to render the score

requirements.title: Win condition
requirements.description: A comparison against a winning number (e.g. >= 5)
